name: ripieno-workspace
description: A shared AI agent room — one conversation, multiple people, one agent that knows who said what.
author: Ivan Hart (@ijmh2)

scripts._comment: test and typecheck build first: relay-client and mcp have no test script of their own, so nothing else builds them, and both the extension's bundler and its typechecker resolve @ripieno/relay-client through its dist. In a working copy that dist is usually lying around from an earlier build, so the missing step only shows up in a fresh clone — which is exactly who it has to work for.
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:relay: npm run build -w @ripieno/protocol && npm run build -w @ripieno/relay
scripts.build:workspace: npm run build -w @ripieno/protocol && npm run build -w @ripieno/relay-client && npm run build -w @ripieno/workspace-core && npm run build -w @ripieno/workspace-host
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w ripieno
